Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap (high level)
- Use case: customer support triage + automated summarization of long-form customer emails.
- Dataset: you mentioned ~50k historical support threads, planning to surface ~500 labeled QA pairs for the initial eval.
- Non-functional constraints: latency SLO ~200ms p95 for inference, high precision on intent classification, strict PII/HIPAA concerns.

Recommended eval plan (what Redwood will run)
- Models to include in the baseline: Llama-3-8B-quant (fast/cost-efficient), Llama-3-13B-quant (better safety/accuracy), and a larger instruction-tuned open model as a quality baseline.
- Prompt sets: recommended instruction templates and few-shot examples attached (bancorp_prompt_set.csv).
- Scoring & metrics: automated metrics (intent classification accuracy, F1 for extraction tasks), hallucination rate (model claims with confidence but no evidence), plus manual human pass/fail checks on a 200-sample subset.
- Acceptance criteria: >92% intent accuracy, hallucination rate <3% on sampled items, p95 latency <250ms on Redwood Dedicated.

What we need from you
- Upload: 500 representative labeled rows in the attached template (redwood_eval_template.xlsx) — CSV export is fine. Include a column marking PII-sensitive examples if applicable.
- Security confirmation: let us know if you want the eval run in your VPC/private deployment (we recommend this for PII).

Next steps
1) You upload the sample CSV to the Drive link or share via secure transfer.
2) We'll spin up an eval project (link below) and run the baseline models, then share a short report + replayable prompt notebook.
3) Schedule a 30m results review the week after the run.

Links / Attachments
- Eval runner (provisioning link): https://redwood.app/evals/runner/DEAL-12345
- Prompt set (attached): bancorp_prompt_set.csv
- Eval template (attached): redwood_eval_template.xlsx

If that looks good I'll have Neha schedule the provisioning call and loop in our security lead for the deployment conversation.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Alex — great questions. Short answers below, more details if helpful on the call.

1) Secure upload & deployment
- We support uploads via an encrypted S3 presigned transfer or direct upload into your VPC Private Eval bucket (recommended). We will not persist data in our hosted tenancy if you select Private Eval. All keys can be customer-managed (KMS/HSM).

2) Hallucination metric
- Definition: a model output that asserts a factual claim (e.g., reference to order numbers, dates, or policy lines) that cannot be corroborated by the input or knowledge base.
- Measurement: automated heuristic matching against the source text + evidence lookup (for claims that reference internal IDs) yields candidate hallucinations, then a manual annotation pass on a 200-sample subset to compute a human-adjusted hallucination rate.
- Threshold: our baseline for production readiness is <3% on the sampled check. We report both raw heuristic and human-adjusted rates.

3) Turnaround
- If you upload the 500 rows by EOD Friday, we can provision the eval project and return a first-pass automated report within 72 hours (includes metric tables, latency p95, and sample failure cases). Full human-reviewed summary is typically +3 business days after that.

I've attached an example prompt set (Drive link) and the eval template you can use. Neha, can you assist with scheduling the provisioning slot and confirm whether Bancorp prefers VPC or hosted?
